about: AI-transparency and consumer-law defects planted in examples/ai-news/faulty by scripts/examples/plant_ai_news.py. scripts/check-content.mjs --expected scores the entries of "defects". kind: code = check-content.mjs is designed to find it (as a non-conformity, or as "to review" when the checker cannot be certain); runtime = needs an interaction the checker does not perform; human = needs a person. Defects that no checker rule covers are listed in "not_scored" with rule null.

defects.summary: The AI-generated illustration of the old town on the front page has neither badge nor caption saying it is generated.
defects.fixed_by: The "AI Generated" badge sits on the image and the caption starts with "Illustration generated by AI.".

defects.summary: The front-page teaser of the unreviewed AI article has lost its label.
defects.fixed_by: Under the teaser headline, the label says the summary and the article were written by AI and not reviewed by an editor.

defects.summary: "Also send me offers from our partners" is ticked by default in the newsletter form.
defects.fixed_by: The partner offers box starts unticked and is marked optional.

defects.summary: The link that declines the newsletter reads "No thanks, I prefer to stay uninformed".
The label of the unreviewed AI article is moved to the end, after the text: readers meet the article before the disclosure.
defects.fixed_by: The label sits under the headline, before the first paragraph.

defects.summary: The AI illustration of the flood barrier is disclosed only in its alt text, which sighted readers do not see.
defects.fixed_by: A visible badge and caption say it was generated by AI; the alt text describes the picture only.

defects.summary: The "AI Modified" badge of the bridge photo is aria-hidden and the caption no longer says the photo was modified, so screen reader users are not told.
defects.fixed_by: The caption says "Photo modified with AI:" and what was changed.

defects.summary: The AI illustration of the reading room is disclosed only in a tooltip (title attribute).
defects.fixed_by: A visible badge and caption say it was generated by AI.

defects.summary: The AI-generated summary of a public-interest article carries only the letters "AI", without saying that it was generated.
defects.fixed_by: The summary starts with "This summary was generated by AI from the article below".

defects.summary: The archive chat has no notice and no badge, its title is "Archive assistant", and AI is only mentioned in the footer link "How we use AI".
defects.fixed_by: The panel shows "You are chatting with an AI assistant, not a person." above the field and an "AI · Not a person" badge.

defects.summary: Each answer of the archive assistant is announced as "Archive helper:", and the greeting no longer says it is an AI.
defects.fixed_by: The speaker label is "AI assistant" and the greeting repeats that it is an AI.

defects.summary: Texts rely on the editorial exception, but the page that names the editor-in-chief no longer gives any contact.
defects.fixed_by: The newsroom section gives the editor-in-chief's name and email address.

defects.summary: The legal notice gives no email address.
defects.fixed_by: The legal notice gives an email address as a mailto link.

defects.summary: The legal notice links to the former EU online dispute resolution platform, which no longer exists.
The privacy policy page has no link to the legal notice.

not_scored.summary: The "Use of AI" page says that every article is reviewed by the editor, which the unreviewed flood-plan article contradicts. Only a person comparing the page with the newsroom's practice can see it.
not_scored.fixed_by: The page says that some texts are generated without editorial review and are labelled "AI Generated".
